expected_result_isolation: static_evaluator.py receives program AST and normalized operand data only. It has no access to packets/expected outcomes or witness identities. The report layer retains expected result after evaluation eligibility is decided.

operator_dependencies.EQ_NE_LT_GT_IN: All exact typed operands; no coerce/unknown-to-zero conversion
operator_dependencies.MISSING: Expected natural key, key-field list and actual row multiset
operator_dependencies.BIJECTION: Both complete protected rosters; duplicates retained
operator_dependencies.role_flags: Exactly one matched full source role row and bound role OID
operator_dependencies.HAS_PUBLIC_PRIVILEGE: Fully normalized object ACL with PUBLIC oid0; null/default expansion provenance remains fixture requirement
operator_dependencies.REACHABLE_ADMIN: Requires implicit database-owner edge composition as well as separately typed explicit options; blocked rather than approximated
operator_dependencies.DEFAULT: Requires full source default ACL and actual creator/schema/future object semantics; blocked
operator_dependencies.SECURITY_DEFINER: Requires execute/schema access, owner and independently verified body/effect closure; blocked
operator_dependencies.WRITE_PATH: Requires full source-expanded effect reachability/admission; blocked

construction_limits: Ready subpredicate evaluators are not full decision/non-grant traces. Missing other implementations are technical work; no project authority invented.
